svg.title: Figure 12 · Parametric fitting and withheld-maturity validation
svg.desc: Thirteen of sixteen synthetic zero-rate quotes enter the equal-weight fit. Quotes at 0.75, 4 and 15 years are withheld. Static fits use multistart SciPy least squares on profiled decay times; browser fitting uses its own bounded search.
